verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no batch or bulk endpoint, no bulk-edit capability, and no multi-item action for entities, evaluations or reviews. The closest item says workflows can run 'on a schedule as a Portfolio workflow'. That is a recurring scheduled evaluation, not a user-initiated bulk operation across many items, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
